structured_output.what_is_happening: A copycat "e/acc / Effective Accelerationism" token was deployed straight to a PumpSwap pool about 12 minutes ago. It does not appear to have migrated from the pump.fun curve (migrated_unix 0, launchpad unknown). The canonical e/acc token (CbcyNo…, $17.9M market cap, created about 4.5h earlier, ~$987k h1 volume) is live and clearly the main one. This pair pumped +225% to a $34.7k market cap on about $200k of volume. Nearly all of that volume came in the first ~15 minutes. GeckoTerminal's latest 5 minutes show volume dropping to about $11k and price down 6.7%. LP is 100% unlocked and held by a few providers. GMGN flags 55 bundler wallets, 47.7% of top-trader activity from bundlers, a 32-wallet insider trade network, and a 39% bot/degen rate. The creator's balance is 0 (status "creator_close"). The listed X link points to a Beff Jezos status, which suggests the whole story is borrowed from the main token's catalyst.

narrative.description: e/acc / Beff Jezos meme. The narrative is real and currently hot, since a $17.9M e/acc token is trading heavily right now. This coin is a late clone riding that attention.
narrative.why_spreading: Spillover from the canonical e/acc token's run and a Beff Jezos post. Buyers are likely sniping 'cheap e/acc' clones, not backing this contract specifically.

token_connection.why_this_token: It only shares the name and ticker. It is not first, has no website or socials, and links to someone else's tweet.
token_connection.competing_tokens: CbcyNo… e/acc ($17.9M mcap, $664k liquidity, canonical and much earlier). GqmEdR… e/acc from 2024 ($135k mcap). There are likely more clones not shown.

authenticity.evidence: 55 bundler wallets make up about 48% of top-trader activity. There is a 32-wallet insider trade network. The buy/seller mismatch is odd: 794 unique buyers but only 60 unique sellers. Liquidity is larger than market cap on a direct PumpSwap deploy with 100% unlocked LP. Nearly all volume came in one 15-minute burst and is now fading.
authenticity.uncertainty: Some of the buyers could be real spillover from the main e/acc run. GMGN's bundler tags on non-pump.fun deploys can be noisy.

structural_risks: 100% of LP unlocked, so it can be pulled at any time
Few LP providers, likely just the deployer
Bundler share is about 48% and there is a 32-wallet insider network
Clone of a much larger canonical token
Volume and price are rolling over in the latest 5 minutes
The creator has closed their position; this deployer's earlier token peaked around $1M

structured_output.counterargument: The e/acc narrative is very hot, with $1M/h of volume on the main token. At $35k, clones can catch overflow from traders looking for a cheap beta play. With 800+ unique buyers in 15 minutes, a second wave could double it from this low base. Mint and freeze authority are renounced, and top-10 holders own only 22%.
unknowns: Whether the 794 buyers are real or bot-distributed wallets
Whether the Beff Jezos post relates to this contract at all
How many other e/acc clones are live right now

structured_output.thesis: This is a bundled, unlocked-LP clone of a hot $18M e/acc token, and its initial burst is already fading. The most likely outcome is a bleed or an LP pull, not a 2x from entry. Its ranking should be below the typical coin in this pool.
